cases.mechanism_detail: A 5'-truncated Alu of a new subfamily (Yk13) in exon IIIc is proposed to disrupt exon IIIc and lead to illegitimate mesenchymal expression of the FGFR2 IIIb isoform (gain of function); the insertion arose in the paternal germline.
cases.quote: Both the deletion and insertion are likely to act by a similar gain-of-function mechanism in which disruption of exon IIIc leads to illegitimate mesenchymal expression of an FGFR2 spliceform containing the alternatively spliced exon IIIb.
